description: This file defines an Angular component named NotesListComponent, which displays a list of notes, handles note selection and deletion, and communicates with parent components via Output events.

classes.name: NotesListComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for displaying and interacting with a list of notes, allowing selection and deletion.

properties.name: notes
properties.description: Array of Note objects to display.

properties.name: selectedNoteId
properties.description: Identifier of the currently selected note, optional.

properties.name: noteSelect
properties.description: EventEmitter for notifying when a note is selected.

properties.name: noteDelete
properties.description: EventEmitter for notifying when a note is to be deleted.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Emits the noteSelect event if a different note is selected.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Stops event propagation and emits the noteDelete event to delete a note.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Selects a note by emitting its ID if it is not already selected.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note by emitting its ID after stopping event propagation.
